changelog: Phase L103.3 — feature gating helpers (pure scaffold, no callsites yet). New lib/Billing/Features.php enumerates 38 atomic feature keys (catalog.*, cart.*, customer.*, order.*, analytics.*, staff.*, inventory.*) and pins each to a minimum tier rank 1-6 via TIER_MATRIX. New lib/Billing/TariffRegistry.php reads from control-plane.tariffs table with per-request cache, exposes publicTiers/ownerSwitchableCodes/priceLabel. Database::getActiveTariff(locationId) and Database::hasFeature(featureKey, locationId) added with fail-open semantics in legacy single-DB mode and catalog.display always-on policy when no subscription. tests/L103FeaturesTest.php locks the matrix contract (no MySQL required). ZERO behaviour change — Phase L103.5 will wire the gates at callsites.
